Lindsay Clancy Trial: Jury Deadlocked After Five-Week Deliberations

Jury deliberations in the trial of Lindsay Clancy, accused of killing her three children, are set to continue into a fifth day after the panel reported being deadlocked. The judge instructed the jurors to return for further deliberations. The trial has lasted five weeks. Clancy's attorney has stated there is no plea deal, and the District Attorney is seeking the maximum penalty. The case has also raised discussions about maternal mental health treatment.
